documents.title: प्रेम
duplicate_review: Possible substantially different variant of existing प्रेमपत्र (premapatr); identity is not confirmed. Source has 3 numbered stanzas; archive has 7 lettered sections.

Source opening तारीफ लाख झुले उपवनमा / केवल आँखा रमायो parallels archive तारीफका कति कुसुम फुलेथे, यात्राको उपवनमा / अरुले आँखा रमाए, followed in both by contrast between others and complete/personal adoption.

Source stanza 3 विश्व बिलाउनु बिन्दु बनीकन parallels archive च विश्व बिलाए बिन्दु बनी तब बिन्दु फुरे भै विश्व–ध्वनि. This ordered conceptual and lexical correspondence warrants edition review despite very low literal n-gram similarity.
Defer creation and do not merge or retitle either text until reference editions establish whether they are independent works, drafts, or variants.
documents.reason: Possible variant/partial relationship with existing प्रेमपत्र; compare editions before creating a new work.
